missions.description: The Exchange maintains standing contracts for bulk nickel ore. Federation infrastructure runs on reliable supply chains.

dialog.offer: The Federation's infrastructure program needs nickel — alloys, plating, components, you name it. I've got authorization for a bulk purchase: 25 units at premium rates. Standard Exchange contract terms apply.

missions.title: Nickel Supply Contract

missions.description: The station needs a steady supply of iron ore to maintain its infrastructure. Mine some and bring it back.

dialog.offer: We're running low on iron ore again. If you can mine 30 units and bring them back, I'll make it worth your while.

missions.title: Iron Supply Run

missions.description: The Exchange is evaluating a new high-value trade corridor. Scout the Cargo Lanes and Gold Run systems to assess commercial viability.

dialog.offer: Captain, the Exchange board has approved a new initiative - the Gold Run Corridor. If viable, it could be the most profitable trade route since Haven was founded. I need a pilot to scout Cargo Lanes and Gold Run - both Federation-adjacent systems. Assess the routes, log the hazards, and report back.

objectives.description: Return route data to the Grand Exchange

missions.title: Scouting the Gold Run

missions.description: The Nebula Trade Federation is commissioning a comprehensive inspection of all Federation stations for a new trade route investment prospectus. Visit every station in Federation space and return with market data.

dialog.offer: The Federation is preparing an investment prospectus for a new generation of optimized trade routes, and we need current data from every station in our network. Market Prime, Cargo Lanes, Gold Run, Factory Belt, Trader's Rest, Treasure Cache, and the Levy — each one a link in the chain that makes the Federation the economic engine of settled space. Dock at each station, let your ship's sensors log the commercial traffic patterns, and bring the full dataset back here. The commission on this contract is generous, because the data is worth ten times what we're paying you.

objectives.description: Dock at Cargo Lanes Freight Depot
Dock at Gold Run Extraction Hub
Dock at Factory Belt Manufacturing Hub
Dock at Trader's Rest Resort Station
Dock at Treasure Cache Trading Post
Dock at the Levy Customs Station
Return to Grand Exchange with market data

missions.title: Federation Trade Route Prospectus

missions.description: The salvage yard foreman needs someone to tow in a wreck. A good way to learn the business.

dialog.offer: New to salvaging? Here's how it works. Wrecks are scattered across the galaxy — left behind after battles, pirate attacks, equipment failures. You need a Basic Tow Rig module first. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one yourself. Then use `install_mod` to fit it in a utility slot. Once equipped, fly to a wreck, use `tow_wreck` to attach it, then haul it back here. Use `sell_wreck` to cash it in. Simple as that.

objectives.description: Sell 1 wreck at a salvage yard

missions.title: First Haul

missions.description: Acquire gas harvesting equipment to expand your resource portfolio. Diversification protects margins.

dialog.offer: Captain, you've been focused on ore — that's fine for starters, but real traders diversify their portfolios. Gas harvesting is an underdeveloped market with strong fundamentals. Acquire a Tier 1 gas harvester using `view_market` and `create_buy_order`, or craft one if you've got the materials and recipes. Either way, get the equipment and come back. The Exchange rewards diversification.

giver.name: Equipment Specialist Ryker
giver.title: Grand Exchange Station, Diversification and Assets

missions.title: Commodity Diversification

missions.description: Fulfill a custom manufacturing order by mining iron and refining it into ingots. Value-added production beats raw commodity sales every time.

dialog.offer: Captain, raw commodities are fine for volume traders, but real margins come from value-added manufacturing. I've got a standing order for iron ingots — mine 10 units of iron ore, then use `catalog` with type `recipes` to find the smelting recipe and `craft` to process it. One ingot is worth triple the raw ore. That's how you build profit.

missions.title: First Commission

missions.description: Learn the Exchange's order book system by listing iron ore for sale. Every portfolio begins with a first position.

dialog.offer: Welcome to the trading floor, Captain. Every station in the Federation has its own order book where buyers and sellers meet. Use `view_market` to see current prices and open orders, then use `create_sell_order` to list 5 units of iron ore. Your order sits on the book at your price until a buyer matches it — or fills instantly if there's already demand.

giver.name: Exchange Analyst Devri
giver.title: Grand Exchange Station, Order Book Operations

objectives.description: List 5 Iron Ore for sale on the exchange

missions.title: Opening Position

missions.description: List items for sale on the station exchange. Any items count toward the goal.

dialog.offer: The exchange needs sellers as much as buyers. List some items for sale - at least 10 units of anything. Use the `create_sell_order` command to put items on the market. There's a small listing fee, but the returns are worth it when buyers come knocking.

objectives.description: Sell 10 units of any item on the exchange

missions.title: Market Participation: Selling

missions.description: Chart nearby star systems to update our navigation databases. Every system you visit helps.

dialog.offer: Our navigation charts are getting stale. If you visit 3 systems I haven't had recent data from, I'll pay for the navigation data.

missions.title: Local Sector Survey

missions.description: Visit all five empire capital systems and return to Haven in the longest route through civilized space.

dialog.offer: The Nebula Trade Federation believes that commerce thrives on connection, and connection requires understanding. I'm commissioning a Grand Tour — one pilot, five empires, every capital visited. Sol, Nexus Prime, Krynn, Haven, and Frontier. You'll carry a Nebula trade charter, which identifies you as a diplomatic observer. It won't stop pirates, but it will open doors at every capital. Visit all five systems and return here. The longest route in civilized space, and one of the most rewarding.

missions.title: Grand Tour of the Five Empires

missions.description: Chart frontier systems to expand our knowledge of the galaxy's outer reaches.

dialog.offer: The Institute needs fresh navigation data from frontier space. Visit The Crucible and Horizon systems - both are in regions where our data is sparse.

missions.title: Deep Space Cartography

missions.description: Deliver platinum ore to Procyon Colonial Station as final settlement of an overdue Federation trade account.

dialog.offer: The Federation Revenue Service has three overdue accounts that have resisted every standard collection method. Polite reminders, escalation notices, frozen trade credentials — nothing. I need someone who can physically travel to each debtor and deliver the settlement terms. First stop: Procyon Colonial Station. The Solarian Confederacy's Procyon colony owes the Federation for a bulk fuel shipment they received six months ago. They claim budget shortfalls, so the Federation is accepting 10 units of platinum ore as payment in kind. Source the platinum and deliver it to Procyon — the Revenue Service will reimburse you plus a generous courier fee.

objectives.description: Deliver 10 Platinum Ore to Procyon Colonial Station

missions.title: Overdue Accounts

missions.description: Titanium is in high demand for hull plating. Mine a batch from the local asteroid belts.

dialog.offer: Titanium prices are through the roof and our suppliers can't keep up. Willing to pay premium rates for 20 units of titanium ore.

missions.title: Titanium Extraction Contract

missions.description: Eliminate a pirate threat near Federation trade lanes. Secure shipping means secure profits.

dialog.offer: Captain, the Exchange has a problem — pirates harassing convoys near our outer trade lanes. Can't have that. Bad for business, bad for margins. I need you to take out one pirate vessel and report back to Haven. Use `attack` to engage hostiles. Federation shipping depends on safe lanes.

giver.name: Security Broker Torin
giver.title: Grand Exchange Station, Trade Protection Division

missions.title: Convoy Defense

missions.description: Hunt down a pirate threatening local shipping lanes. Any pirate will do - the station pays for confirmed kills.

dialog.offer: We've got pirates disrupting trade in the region and the station is posting bounties. Take one out and bring proof. Use the `attack` command when you find one - pirates tend to spawn in lawless systems with low police presence. Fair warning: they shoot back, so watch your hull.

missions.title: Pirate Bounty

missions.description: Establish the first links of the Grand Circuit trade route by delivering inaugural shipments to Market Prime and Cargo Lanes.

dialog.offer: The Commerce Bureau is establishing a galaxy-spanning trade route — the Grand Circuit. Every major market connected by a single optimized shipping lane. But a route on paper is worthless. We need inaugural shipments to prove the lanes are viable. Start here at Grand Exchange: load up Copper Wiring and deliver it to Market Prime, then extend the run to Cargo Lanes with a shipment of nickel ore. Two stops, two deliveries, and the first links in the Circuit are forged.

objectives.description: Deliver Copper Wiring to Market Prime
Deliver nickel ore to Cargo Lanes

missions.title: First Links

missions.description: Extract Prismatic Nebulite from the deep core gas pockets near Federation space. A new commodity class for the Exchange.

dialog.offer: The deposits are verified and the Exchange is ready to list prismatic nebulite as a new commodity class. But we need physical inventory first. Mine 10 units from the deep core gas pockets you discovered. You'll need a deep core extractor — standard gas harvesters can't handle the density of these formations.

missions.title: Nebulite Extraction

missions.description: CRITICAL PHASE 5 OBJECTIVE: Transport all optical_fiber_bundles to Haven Grand Exchange for immediate market deployment at premium prices (1800cr/ea at Haven). Time-sensitive market window. Any member with bundles should deliver immediately. This is the core Phase 5 revenue generator.

objectives.description: Consolidate all 80 optical_fiber_bundles to Haven Grand Exchange

missions.title: PHASE 5: Optical Fiber Bundle Transport to Haven

missions.description: Install cargo expansion modules to increase payload capacity. Bigger holds mean bigger profit per run.

dialog.offer: Captain, you're leaving money on the table every time you undock with unfilled cargo space. A Tier 1 cargo expander adds 50 units of capacity — that's 50 more units you can haul per trip. More payload per jump means better margins. Use `view_market` to find one on the exchange and `buy` to purchase it, or craft one if you've got the materials. Then use `install_mod` to mount it on your ship.

giver.name: Fleet Optimization Advisor Chen
giver.title: Grand Exchange Station, Ship Efficiency Division

missions.title: Cargo Optimization

missions.description: Investigate reports of a spatial anomaly near Starfall — it may be a wormhole.

dialog.offer: Our route analysis models are flagging unusual spatial readings near the Starfall system — consistent with wormhole formation. If a wormhole can shorten trade routes by 15 or more jumps, the profit margins would be extraordinary. I need someone to verify this. You'll need a survey scanner module to locate the entrance — sensor arrays, circuit boards, and focused crystals, basic crafting and scanning skills. Head to Starfall and run survey_system in that area and nearby systems.

giver.name: Director Orin Voss
giver.title: Route Analysis Bureau, Grand Exchange Station

objectives.description: Return to Director Orin Voss with your findings

missions.title: Anomalous Readings

missions.description: Certain parties at Grand Exchange Station are willing to pay well for 3 Ghost Rounds, no questions asked. Source the goods from pirate space — the Treasure Cache Trading Post or any pirate stronghold should have what you need — and deliver them here. Discretion is expected.

objectives.description: Deliver 3 Ghost Rounds to Grand Exchange Station

missions.title: Black Market: Ghost Rounds

missions.description:
Contained Low Enriched Uranium is in demand at Deep Range Outpost. Buy 8 units here for approximately 9718 credits each, then haul them to Deep Range Outpost (13 jumps) and sell for approximately 12182 credits each. Estimated profit: ~19712 credits.

This route crosses empire borders. Watch for pirates in lawless space between empires.

Use 'create_buy_order' to purchase the goods, then 'travel' and 'jump' to reach the destination. Use 'create_sell_order' at the destination to complete the trade and earn your profit.

objectives.description: Sell 8 Contained Low Enriched Uranium at Deep Range Outpost

missions.title: Trade Run: Contained Low Enriched Uranium to Deep Range Outpost
